sources.ref: arkona-site.html (saved copy of the Arkona homepage)

name.note: The site name in the page metadata; the footer adds the legal form ApS, which documents leave off.

colors.primary.note: The deep green of the logo, the navigation, the links and the buttons.

colors.foreground.note: The site's text color, a green-tinted near-black.

colors.secondary.note: The warm sand of the band behind your materials section and the hover on outline buttons.

typography.body.note: The site's text face, an open font from Google Fonts.

typography.heading.note: The site's heading face, an open serif from Google Fonts.

typography.headingWeight.note: Headings on the site are set semibold (600).

logo.note: The ARKONA wordmark with the larch A, from the site header, in one green.

voice.register.value: plain, concrete, craft-proud; short sentences, facts over adjectives

voice.sample.value: Larch from the Baltic coast grows slowly, so the wood is dense and resinous. We leave it untreated or oil it once.

notes.name: We used Arkona, the name in your site's metadata and footer, without the ApS.
notes.logo: The wordmark from the top of your website, used as it is in your green, and in light ink when a reader uses dark mode.
notes.tone: You write short, concrete sentences about materials and making, and let numbers do the persuading.
